title: Modified function formatPrice to round to the nearest cent
context: A price with half a cent or more left over was shown one cent too low. Every price in the catalogue and in the cart now shows the nearest cent. A price that is a whole number of cents shows as it did before.
- **When** a product costs 1999.5 cents, **then** [its card in the catalogue shows `$20.00`](code:src/routes/catalog/components/ProductCard.tsx#L10), where it showed `$19.99`.
- **When** a cart line comes to 1999.5 cents, **then** [the line shows `$20.00`](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartLine.tsx#L12), where it showed `$19.99`.
- **When** the cart comes to 1999.5 cents, **then** [the total shows `$20.00`](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartSummary.tsx#L18), where it showed `$19.99`.
- **When** an amount is 1999.4 cents, **then** nothing changes: the price still shows `$19.99`.
- **When** an amount is a whole number of cents, **then** nothing changes.
- Modified [`formatPrice()`](code:src/lib/format.ts#formatPrice) to round `priceCents` with `Math.round`, where it used `Math.floor`.

nodes.label: Formats an amount in cents as a price in US dollars
nodes.description:
Two Entry Points reach this function.

- When a shopper opens the catalogue at /, `<CatalogPage />` [renders one `<ProductCard />` per product](code:src/routes/catalog/index.tsx#L10-14), and [`<ProductCard />` calls this function with `product.priceCents`](code:src/routes/catalog/components/ProductCard.tsx#L10).
- When a shopper opens the cart at /cart, `<CartPage />` [renders one `<CartLine />` per item](code:src/routes/cart/index.tsx#L11-13) and [one `<CartSummary />`](code:src/routes/cart/index.tsx#L15). [`<CartLine />` calls this function with `item.product.priceCents * item.quantity`](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartLine.tsx#L12), and [`<CartSummary />` calls this function with `totalCents`](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartSummary.tsx#L18).

nodes.impactReason: [`<CartLine />` renders `formatPrice(item.product.priceCents * item.quantity)`](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartLine.tsx#L12), so a line that comes to 1999.5 cents now shows `$20.00` where it showed `$19.99`.

[`<CartSummary />` renders `formatPrice(totalCents)`](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartSummary.tsx#L18), so a cart that comes to 1999.5 cents now shows a total of `$20.00` where it showed `$19.99`.

[`<ProductCard />` renders `formatPrice(product.priceCents)`](code:src/routes/catalog/components/ProductCard.tsx#L10), so a product at 1999.5 cents now shows `$20.00` where it showed `$19.99`. No code in this file makes `priceCents` a whole number before the call.

files.title: The price formatter rounds to the nearest cent
summary: Modified [`formatPrice()`](code:src/lib/format.ts#formatPrice) to round `priceCents` with `Math.round`, where it used `Math.floor`.

waypoints.title: Modified `formatPrice()` to round to the nearest cent
waypoints.reading: The author modified a function `formatPrice()` that now returns `$20.00` for 1999.5 cents, up from `$19.99`. `Math.round` replaces `Math.floor`, so 1999.4 cents still returns `$19.99`, and a whole number of cents returns the same text as before. [`<ProductCard />` calls it for the price of a product](code:src/routes/catalog/components/ProductCard.tsx#L10), [`<CartLine />` calls it for the total of a line](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartLine.tsx#L12) and [`<CartSummary />` calls it for the total of the cart](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartSummary.tsx#L18), so that every price in the catalogue and in the cart shows the nearest cent. No code in this repository produces a fraction of a cent: `priceCents` arrives in the `/products` response that `fetchProducts()` in `src/api/products.ts` requests, and the cart multiplies it by a whole quantity and adds the lines.
